# Unbound declarations

<!-- Generated by lithon-codegen from unbound.json: edit that, then rerun `lithon-codegen sdl3 spec`. -->

hs-bindgen does not bind these declarations of the SDL 3.4.16 headers. [`unbound.json`](unbound.json) gives each one a disposition, and `spec` and `generate` fail on a skip without one and on a disposition for a name that is bound now.

| Disposition | Skips |
| ----------- | ----: |
| `shim`      |    53 |
| `constant`  |    55 |
| `wontfix`   |    95 |
| `upstream`  |    11 |

- `shim`: a lithon-authored C shim binds it instead.
- `constant`: lithon binds its value as a typed constant (`constants.json`).
- `wontfix`: it stays unbound on purpose.
- `upstream`: it waits on an hs-bindgen fix.

## `shim` (11)

Variadic, so the FFI has no type for them; lithon's C shims pass the message verbatim, never as a format string.

- `SDL_SetError` (SDL_error.h:89): variadic
- `SDL_IOprintf` (SDL_iostream.h:661): variadic
- `SDL_Log` (SDL_log.h:248): variadic
- `SDL_LogTrace` (SDL_log.h:272): variadic
- `SDL_LogVerbose` (SDL_log.h:295): variadic
- `SDL_LogDebug` (SDL_log.h:319): variadic
- `SDL_LogInfo` (SDL_log.h:343): variadic
- `SDL_LogWarn` (SDL_log.h:367): variadic
- `SDL_LogError` (SDL_log.h:391): variadic
- `SDL_LogCritical` (SDL_log.h:415): variadic
- `SDL_LogMessage` (SDL_log.h:440): variadic

## `upstream` (4)

Function-like macros over same-name inline functions; hs-bindgen drops both halves of the clash. The _builtin variants are bound.

Issue: <https://github.com/well-typed/hs-bindgen/issues/2097>

- `SDL_size_mul_check_overflow` (SDL_stdinc.h:6095): conflict with a same-name declaration (SDL_stdinc.h:6095, SDL_stdinc.h:6113)
- `macro SDL_size_mul_check_overflow` (SDL_stdinc.h:6095): conflict with a same-name declaration (SDL_stdinc.h:6095, SDL_stdinc.h:6113)
- `SDL_size_add_check_overflow` (SDL_stdinc.h:6134): conflict with a same-name declaration (SDL_stdinc.h:6134, SDL_stdinc.h:6151)
- `macro SDL_size_add_check_overflow` (SDL_stdinc.h:6134): conflict with a same-name declaration (SDL_stdinc.h:6134, SDL_stdinc.h:6151)

## `upstream` (2)

Token pasting through glibc's INT64_C and UINT64_C, which hs-bindgen's macro parser cannot expand.

Issue: <https://github.com/well-typed/hs-bindgen/issues/1698>

- `macro SDL_SINT64_C` (SDL_stdinc.h:403): needs `macro INT64_C` (not selected); macro-typecheck: `Failed to typecheck macro: Unbound variable: 'INT64_C'`
